description: Bus Stop Clearway London Road issued per month from September 2017 is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This data highlights total number of Penalty Charge Notices issued per month with income value. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Parking and Mobility. Its keywords are Clearway, PCN, Penalty Charge Notice, Bus Stop. The portal shows 19 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2019-05-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
